scope: 70M10routes and160M29routes;each model,checkpoint,and operator fitted separately;19checkpoints;no pooled fit
target: Native single-route-removal correct-successor attention decrease,percentage points;equal query/copy/context/token weight
predictors: Comparison-weighted structural margin/component summaries;full position margins include R
fit: OLS with intercept;each fixed endpoint-selected route is one observation;unweighted across routes within one case
interpretation: Descriptive in-sample associations on an endpoint-selected cohort;shared Readers are not independent;not cross-validated prediction or causal attribution;negative early decreases retained

mean_G.label: Mean G (μG)
mean_G.definition: Comparison-weighted mean of G for the selected operator

G_over_std.label: Mean G / own std (μG / σG)
G_over_std.definition: mean(G) / population_standard_deviation(G); the denominator is G own standard deviation, not the margin standard deviation

mean_m.label: Mean m (μm)
mean_m.definition: Comparison-weighted mean of the complete position margin, including R

m_over_std.label: Mean m / own std (μm / σm)
m_over_std.definition: mean(m) / population_standard_deviation(m); separate from mean divided by variance
